# Azury Labs

> Azury Labs is a software and applied-AI company with presence in Mexico,
> Colombia and the United States. It builds its own products and custom
> solutions so companies can sell, operate and decide with data. It offers
> eight product lines, each solving a different part of the business.

## Products

- **Iruz Atenea** — Platform to create AI agents that handle messages and
  voice in real time, know the business, connect to its systems and execute
  real processes. https://v3.atenea.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz Lindex** — Autonomous software engineering harness. Coordinates AI
  agents from ticket to code, tests and a deployed preview, with isolated
  execution, full traceability and per-task budget control. Integrates with
  Linear, Jira, GitHub, GitLab and Cloudflare Pages. https://lindex.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz Sales OS** — Omnichannel sales operating system (CRM) that connects
  channels, AI agents and human teams to qualify and advance every
  opportunity. https://crm.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz Mi Negocio** — Business management: customers, quotes, orders and
  follow-up in one simple operation. https://minegocio.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz CIEE** — Data and research: AI-driven surveys, opinion studies and
  political or market polling. https://ciee.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz Systems** — Custom software development, technology consulting and
  guided implementation. https://systems.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz Connect** — The official WhatsApp API for businesses and applications,
  without the technical complexity of Meta. Handles credentials, webhooks and
  message statuses. Next channels: Instagram, Messenger, SMS, RCS and voice.
  https://connect.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz Tracking System** — Product analytics that measures every step of the
  customer journey, from first contact to sale, using trackable links and QR
  codes. https://go.iruzlabs.com/+

Channels supported by Atenea agents include WhatsApp Business, Telegram,
Instagram Messenger, phone calls and Google Calendar.
